en: Muhammad ibn Muhammad ibn Yahya Abu al-Wafa al-Buzjani
tr: Muhammed b. Muhammed b. Yahyâ Ebü'l-Vefâ el-Bûzcânî
ar: محمد بن محمد بن يحيى أبو الوفاء البوزجاني

description.tr: Küresel trigonometrinin öncüsü, tanjant ve sekant fonksiyonlarını sistematize etti || Bûzcânî'nin sinüs tabloları çağının en doğrusuydu. || [Tarih notu] Eski Avrupa kaynaklarında sıklıkla karıştırılır.
description.en: Pioneered spherical trigonometry, established tangent and secant functions, sine tables accurate to 8 decimal places || Al-Buzjani's sine tables were the most accurate of their era. His work completed the six standard trigonometric functions still used today. || [Historiographical note] Often confused with Abu al-Wafa of Khorasan in older European scholarship.
description.ar: رائد علم المثلثات الكروية || كانت جداول جيب البوزجاني أدق جداول عصره
